complete_report_CPU_cost.driver_source:
"""Uninstrumented retained analyze_rgbd cost, with all comparisons outside timing."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,platform,sys,time
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();B=a.bundle.resolve();R=B/'source';sys.path.insert(0,str(R));os.environ['SO101_STATION_ROOT']=str(R)
from tools import native_geometry_oracle as o
import numpy as np,cv2
cv2.setNumThreads(1)
assert os.environ.get('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS')=='1' and os.environ.get('OMP_NUM_THREADS')=='1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pins=json.loads((B/'source-pins.json').read_text())
for n,h in pins.items():assert sha(R/n)==h,n
expected=json.loads((B/'matrix-v2.json').read_text());mh=sha(B/'matrix-v2.json');rows=[]
def summary(ns):
 x=np.asarray(ns,dtype=np.float64)/1e6
 return {'samples_ms':x.tolist(),'p50_ms':float(np.percentile(x,50)),'p95_ms':float(np.percentile(x,95)),'mean_ms':float(x.mean())}
for case in expected['cases']:
 name=case['name'];manifest,arrays=o.load_verified(B/'matrix-v2-full'/name);args=o.restore_arrays(manifest['inputs'],arrays)
 wanted=case['reference']['report'];before=o.analyze_reference(args);o.assert_report_equal(wanted,o.plain_values(before))
 for _ in range(3):o.analyze_reference(args)
 wall=[];cpu=[]
 for _ in range(20):
  c=time.process_time_ns();w=time.perf_counter_ns();report=o.analyze_reference(args);wall.append(time.perf_counter_ns()-w);cpu.append(time.process_time_ns()-c)
  o.assert_report_equal(wanted,o.plain_values(report))
 after=o.analyze_reference(args);o.assert_report_equal(wanted,o.plain_values(after));o.assert_report_equal(before,after,tolerance=0)
 rows.append(dict(name=name,shape=list(args['depth'].shape),pixels=int(args['depth'].size),objects=len(report['objects']),diagnostics=o.plain_values(report['validation_diagnostics']),wall=summary(wall),process_CPU=summary(cpu),full_report_parity_before_every_timed_result_after=True,untimed_before_after_bit_exact=True,input_snapshot_sha256=sha(B/'matrix-v2-full'/name/'manifest.json')))
for n,h in pins.items():assert sha(R/n)==h,n
assert sha(B/'matrix-v2.json')==mh
result=dict(scope='Uninstrumented unchanged complete retained CPU analyze_rgbd on synthetic frozen v2 inputs; no FPS/control/headroom/performance-adoption claim',warmup=3,repetitions=20,comparison_timing='All parity and serialization outside timed calls; no tracing/profiling wrappers',host=platform.node(),python=sys.version,executable=sys.executable,numpy=np.__version__,opencv=cv2.__version__,threads={'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'],'OMP_NUM_THREADS':os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'],'OpenCV':cv2.getNumThreads()},host_isolation='No affinity/power/host workload reservation',source_input_pins_before_after=pins,matrix_manifest_sha256=mh,cases=rows)
with a.output.open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'host':result['host'],'cases':len(rows),'all_parity_pass':True,'output':str(a.output)}))
